## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: The inline value-signal assertion re-reviewed-LOC / total-LOC < 50% holds — this script performs the computation
- DD4: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (GREEN phase after T2 RED test passes)

## Description
Implement `plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh`. This script computes the re-review ratio for a completed sprint by comparing the LOC in reviewer-findings.json file references against total story-branch LOC.

### Interface
```
Usage: compute-rereviewed-loc.sh <session-dir> <story-id> [<story-id> ...]

Arguments:
  session-dir  — directory containing per-story reviewer-findings.json files
                 (named <story-id>/reviewer-findings.json)
  story-id...  — one or more story IDs whose branches were merged

Environment:
  SESSION_BRANCH — git branch name for the sprint session (default: current branch)

Output (stdout, one per line):
  TOTAL_LOC:<n>         — total net LOC across all story branches
  REREVIEWED_LOC:<n>    — LOC in files flagged for re-review across all findings
  RATIO:<float>         — REREVIEWED_LOC / TOTAL_LOC, 2 decimal places (e.g., 0.40)

Exit codes:
  0 — computation complete (regardless of ratio value)
  1 — runtime error
  2 — usage error
```

### Algorithm
1. For each story-id: locate `<session-dir>/<story-id>/reviewer-findings.json`
2. Parse findings to extract the set of unique files flagged for re-review in this story
3. Compute the story branch LOC: `git diff --stat <session-branch>..story/<story-id>` (or `git diff --numstat merge-base..tip` if branch still exists); sum insertions + deletions
4. For re-reviewed LOC: for each flagged file, count LOC in the story-branch delta (`git diff --numstat` filtered to that file); sum across all flagged files
5. Accumulate TOTAL_LOC and REREVIEWED_LOC across all stories
6. Compute RATIO = REREVIEWED_LOC / TOTAL_LOC (if TOTAL_LOC == 0: emit RATIO:0.00 and warn)
7. Emit the three output lines in order: TOTAL_LOC, REREVIEWED_LOC, RATIO

### Prior Art
- `plugins/dso/scripts/capture-review-diff.sh` — diff capture pattern with exclusions
- `plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/sprint-review-scope-check.sh` — reviewer-findings.json file parsing pattern
- `plugins/dso/scripts/review-stats.py` — JSONL review event aggregation patterns

## File Impact
- `plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh` (create)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Script exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh
- [ ] All 5 behavioral tests in test-compute-rereviewed-loc.sh pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-compute-rereviewed-loc.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -E 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Script emits TOTAL_LOC, REREVIEWED_LOC, RATIO lines
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh /dev/null 2>&1 | grep -qE '^(TOTAL_LOC|REREVIEWED_LOC|RATIO):' || (echo "usage error expected"; exit 0)
- [ ] Script uses mktemp for any temp files (never hardcoded /tmp paths)
  Verify: grep -v 'mktemp' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh | grep -qv '/tmp/[a-z_-]*\.' && echo "no hardcoded tmp paths" || grep 'mktemp' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh | grep -q 'mktemp'
- [ ] ShellCheck passes with no errors
  Verify: shellcheck $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
